risks.risk: Mounting clips or tabs could be broken, affecting installation
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all clip/tab mounting points from multiple angles

risks.risk: Watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' could be a generic seller tag rather than proof of authenticity
risks.proof: Unwatermarked photo matching the same part, or seller's business registration/listing page

proof_requests: Photo of the part number or OEM stamp on the plastic
Close-up of the reverse side showing full condition
Photo of all mounting clips/tabs intact
Confirmation of exact Honda/Acura model and year this unit was pulled from
Additional angle shots to rule out cracks or warping
response.reason: The witness confirms a generic Honda/Acura branded plastic trim/body panel, so it can be priced at worst case for unconfirmed fitment, unknown clip condition, and unverified authenticity; the seller's broader engine/suspension and universal fitment claims are not supported by the single photo.
